title: ✍️ Writers & publishers meetup
description: Calling all writers and publishers at Web Summit: your people are here! 🙌🏼.Exchange insights, discuss challenges, and expand your network. Join us!

title: The techstyle stack
description: The clothes you're wearing come from a trillion-dollar industry that still runs largely in the dark. In this session, Tony Fadell, creator of the iPod and founder of Nest, joins Physical AI company Smartex.ai and global fashion leader H&M to show how intelligent hardware is transforming one of the world's largest supply chains. From fabric mill to finished garment, learn how deep technology is bringing light to a supply chain few thought could change.

title: Unhold your customers. Hold onto loyalty.
description: Explore the dark journey that customer interaction dashboards miss. Parloa CMO Latané Conant shares how to measure AI agent performance, manage risk, and scale across channels.

title: Beyond the logo: The real value of an F1 partnership
description: Formula 1 is the fastest-growing sport in the world – and every brand wants to get involved. But the hard part is creating value beyond the grid. This session unpacks lessons from building one of the sport's biggest partnerships, revealing what makes sponsorships compound over time, why logo and hospitality aren’t enough, and how brands can turn an F1 partnership into a lasting growth engine.

title: How does patient capital accelerate innovation and technology?
description: Patience sounds like the opposite of speed. In deep tech, it’s often what makes speed possible. Kim Chong, Chief Risk Officer at the Hong Kong Investment Corporation Limited, explains how long-term capital speeds innovation up: it frees founders to build, carries innovative breakthroughs from lab to market, and brings market long term capital in behind them.

title: Is quantum the next frontier of the AI race?
description: Can quantum technologies deliver the acceleration silicon no longer can? Join quantum industry leaders as they debate where quantum acceleration genuinely matters for AI, and confront the harder question: is quantum a decisive edge in the AI race, or a parallel track defining its own?

title: The athlete advantage
description: Today's athletes are building brands, investing in businesses and using their platforms to create meaningful change. Belgium's record international and founder Jan Vertonghen, APEX's Koen Bosma to explore how athletes are turning their experiences, influence and ideas into new ventures and social impact.

title: Regulating for growth: Building the regulator of the future
description: In an era of rapid technological shift and market transformation, regulatory bodies are redefining their role—moving from reactive gatekeepers to proactive catalysts for economic expansion. This intimate fireside chat explores how modern regulators can balance risk mitigation with the mandate to foster innovation and global competitiveness.

title: Viable systems, judgement, and AI safety
description: This talk explores how the Good Regulator Theorem can guide safe AI delegation, highlighting that AI agents excel at data processing and algorithmic accounting. However, building truly safe and viable systems requires preserving human judgment, authority, and ultimate responsibility.

title: Proving innovation in an age of distrust
description: Deepfakes with AI and CGI have made consumers increasingly skeptical of technology claims. This session explores how brands can cut through distrust with authentic transparency, from live demonstrations to real-world experiences at scale. Hyundai's robotics vision – from CES to the FIFA World Cup – demonstrates why turning audiences into witnesses has become the ultimate strategy for proving breakthrough innovation.

title: The autonomous enterprise: Networks, cloud and AI agents
description: Networks, cloud infrastructure and AI are converging to change how companies operate and how customers interact with digital services. As networks become more autonomous and AI agents move from experimentation into real-world applications, organisations face new opportunities and challenges regarding how these technologies should be deployed at scale. SGF Global CEO Mauricio Sion and MEO CTO José Nascimento explore practical applications that can improve customer and business experiences while developing and scaling AI agents.

title: Nomads with roots: The ecosystem of the future
description: Technology has made the world a smaller place. We can travel, communicate, and interact across continents in a matter of minutes. These changes present myriad challenges for those building communities rooted in a particular location, but they also present immense opportunities. In this panel we hear from seasoned ecosystem builders about how to craft a thriving community of technology builders, in a world of digital nomads.

title: 🎓 Student-founded startups meetup
description: Building a startup between lectures? Investors want proof, not promises, so let’s get you ready 🚀! Meet fellow student founders, share what’s working, and find your co-founder. See you there!

title: Top 3 must haves for the marketing tech stack in 2027 [Hosted by Comarch]
description:
AI can analyze data and predict behaviors in real time. Your tech stack needs to build a continuous, trusted relationship loop, regardless of the transaction touch-point. Learn the top 3 pillars of the modern marketing tech stack.
Please be aware that attendance is first-come, first-served.

title: Find your Source Code: Know your stage, make your move [Hosted by Black Innovation Alliance]
description: Think you know where your startup really stands? Experience Source Code. Pinpoint your stage, see what needs attention, explore your personalized Blueprint and ongoing guidance, and make your next move. Please be aware that attendance is first-come, first-served.

title: Is VC playing it too safe?
description: Venture capital was built to fund the impossible, yet a decade of cheap capital has turned it into a consensus-driven machine chasing safe metrics. Outsized returns require solitary conviction. Join this session as we move past the hype to explore the true mechanics of contrarian investing, finding non-obvious opportunities, and spotting frontier markets years before they become obvious.

title: Front-end developer meetup
description: Calling all front-end developers! Join this meetup to share workflows, exchange technical insights, and grow your network

title: 🎮 Gamers, AR & VR meetup
description: What's the next big shift in Gaming, AR & VR? Debate it with peers who are living it 🚀. Connect with peers shaping the future of your field. Looking forward to seeing you!

title: SPUR Coalition: The fight to save the news industry
description: The news media industry is arguably the most exposed industry to technology. Artificial intelligence in particular is upending its business models, the role of the journalist and changing information ecosystems. For the first time ever, media groups have banded together to form the SPUR Coalition which sets out rules, standards and AI infrastructure for how the media works and AI companies will work together. This panel brings together executives from three founding member groups, Sky News, Associated Press, and The Financial Times to discuss how this growing coalition of the world's top news organisations plan to evolve and protect the industry as a whole from prevailing and unregulated tech forces.

timeslot_participations.name: Matthew Rogerson
timeslot_participations.job_title: Director of Global Public Policy & Platform Strategy

title: Who shapes US foreign policy?
description: In money driven electoral systems, campaign finance can play a disproportionate role in public policy outcomes. In this talk Eli Clifton discusses his new book Israel’s Lobby: America in the Grip of a Foreign Power. He explores how lobbying, campaign finance, and elite influence have evolved and why the relationship between the US and Israel has become one of the most consequential and contested issues in American politics.

title: Earth data for enterprise: the key to next-level growth
description: As AI moves into enterprise workflows, success will depend not just on models, but on the quality, scale and accessibility of the data behind them. In this session, AI and data infrastructure leaders will explore where current data pipelines fall short, how to make real-world data accessible to AI and agentic systems, and what becomes possible when data, infrastructure and models work together.

title: Is the AI bubble already bursting?
description: Investors have priced a lot of good news into AI, but real-world spending data tells a more complicated story. Ramp economist Ara Kharazian tracks business spending to reveal hidden weak spots, vendor concentration, and market risks. Join Ara as he puts the AI thesis under pressure to test what might already be going wrong. Bring your phone to participate in live audience voting at the start and end of the session.

timeslot_participations.name: Ara Kharazian
timeslot_participations.job_title: Lead Economist and Head of Economics Lab

timeslot_participations.name: Luke Vargas
timeslot_participations.job_title: Podcast Host of WSJ's What's News

title: Send, scale, reinvent: how to keep building after product-market fit
description: LemFi co-founder and CEO Ridwan shares how the company scaled from a remittance product into a global financial platform serving more than two million customers. Ridwan unpacks the growth decisions behind LemFi’s journey, from raising significant funding and entering investing to integrating stablecoin settlement rails through partnerships with Tether and BVNK.

title: When AI meets the physical world
description: AI is no longer confined to screens and software. As connectivity, sensors and intelligent systems become more embedded in business and cities, companies are beginning to rethink how operations can be monitored, automated and optimised in real time. Samsara VP of Product Praveen Murugesan discusses how companies can move from collecting data to using it to make physical operations safer, smarter and more autonomous.

title: Rewriting the rules of female longevity
description: Women’s health has long been approached in fragments, often reactive and disconnected, leaving major gaps in how women understand their bodies and navigate different stages of life. This session introduces a new product that brings together health intelligence, personalization and technology to help women take a more proactive role in living healthier for longer. What could a new approach to female longevity look like?

title: The mask in the mirror
description: As AI learns to imitate us, what decides who we become? As the face of DeepTomCruise and co-founder of Metaphysic, Miles Fisher has experienced synthetic identity from the inside, amassing over 5 million TikTok followers and 500 million views. In a funny, personal and visually compelling talk, he asks what happens when AI can convincingly manufacture almost anything, and argues that the scarce human skill will not be authenticity, but authorship.

title: China founders × global investors & tech industry meetup
description:
Calling all Chinese founders, global investors and industry players interested in China's tech and innovation scene! 
Join us to share perspectives and explore opportunities between China and the rest of the world. No keynotes, just real conversations on funding, customers and partnerships. Come say hi, we'd love to meet you!

title: Who wants to go public? Inside the new IPO tech boom
description: After years of subdued activity, the technology IPO market is showing signs of a revival. A new generation of high-growth companies (e.g Anthropic) are considering going public. But what is driving the new IPO boom and are valuations justified? Financial experts Patrick Boyle and Adam Kobeissi examine the forces behind the IPO revival, the companies preparing to take the plunge, and whether this new wave represents genuine opportunity, or irrational exuberance.

description: What's the next big shift in Web3, crypto & blockchain? Debate it with peers who are living it 🚀. Connect with peers shaping the future of your field. Looking forward to seeing you!

description: Meet startups from across the State and City of São Paulo, Brazil, taking innovation global and representing Latin America’s most dynamic innovation ecosystem. Connect with founders and leaders in a session by the São Paulo State Secretariat for Science, Technology and Innovation, InvestSP, the state's investment promotion agency, and ADE SAMPA, the city's development agency.

title: The last days of the rules-based order?
description: Wars, great-power rivalry and competing visions of sovereignty are putting the international legal system under extraordinary strain. In this talk, Mary Robinson, Henry Farrell, and Victor Gao ask whether the rules-based order is entering a period of fundamental transformation and what, if anything, could replace it.

timeslot_participations.name: Henry Farrell
timeslot_participations.job_title: SNF Agora Institute Professor of International Affairs

title: Flow state: A game designer's take on AI
description: Game design asks a question most product thinking skips: not what people want or need, but how they feel. That calculus is more relevant than ever today, as the best AI tools are winning users by hitting on the same mix of mastery, flow and unpredictable reward that makes games so absorbing. In this session, Rahul Vohra, a game designer before he founded Superhuman, will discuss why the best AI tools tap into intrinsic motivation rather than extrinsic reward, and how product teams can build for it deliberately.

title: Garbage in, hallucinations out: Building clean data pipelines for AI
description: Everyone is obsessed with shiny new models, but your AI is only as smart as the junk you feed it. This panel dives into how curated training datasets and high-accuracy search processes eliminate model hallucinations. Developers will walk away with a practical blueprint for structuring data pipelines that turn noisy, real-world inputs into reliable, production-ready AI outputs.

title: Book signing: Israel's Lobby: America in the Grip of a Foreign Power by Eli Clifton and Ian Lustick
description: Book signing with author of Israel's Lobby, Eli Clifton. Limited numbers, don't miss out!

title: Trump, tech and the global, mafioso casino
description: Who gets to profit when the President moves the markets? In this talk Aaron Bastani and David Sirota investigate the increasingly blurred line between political power and financial gain in Trump’s America. From insider information and prediction markets to Wall Street and Big Tech, they examine a system where privileged access can potentially turn political decisions into private fortunes, and consider what this means for democracy, accountability and the global economy.

timeslot_participations.name: David Sirota
timeslot_participations.job_title: Co-founder/Editor in Chief, and Oscar nominated screenwriter (Don't look up)

title: Can a tech company grow by getting people off its app?
description: What happens when success means your customers leave? This conversation explores the business behind building something designed to be deleted, and how helping people build relationships shapes product decisions, earns trust and drives growth. As AI changes how people meet and communicate, we will examine which parts of connecting technology can improve, which require human effort, and what other businesses can learn from building around what happens after someone closes the app.

title: Reskilling at the speed of AI [Hosted by Studyfetch]
description: AI is changing jobs faster than training can keep up. Hear from a company and the people it reskilled on what worked, what didn't, and how to move at the pace of change. Please be aware that attendance is first-come, first-served.

title: Building the infrastructure for AI everywhere
description: As AI shifts from models we query to agents that reason and act continuously, the demands on computing are changing fast. This talk explores whether AI's infrastructure - compute, energy, data centres, the CPU's evolving role - can keep pace, and what it takes for countries and companies to capture the value of the AI era.

title: 🔬 Data analysts meetup
description: Calling all data analysts at Web Summit: your people are here! 🙌🏼.Exchange insights, discuss challenges, and expand your network. Join us!

title: AICEP: Connecting Portuguese startups to global markets [Hosted by AICEP]
description: Discover how AICEP supports startup internationalization. AICEP experts from France, UK, Brazil and San Francisco will share market insights, ecosystem trends and growth opportunities. Please be aware that attendance is first-come, first-served.

title: What is really wrong with AI?
description: It's not superintelligence, it's not p(doom), it's not an impending apocalypse; the real problems with AI are how we are building it and what we are doing with it. From data centres to job losses, water usage to slop, this discussion will explore what is really wrong with AI and how we might be able to do better.

timeslot_participations.name: Carissa Véliz
timeslot_participations.company_name: Oxford Institute for Ethics in AI

title: Novara Media presents: The political circus
description: Politics is serious. Politics is important. And sometimes, politics is completely ridiculous. Novara Media brings its sharp, irreverent take on the political circus to the stage for a lively look at the stories, scandals and absurdities dominating the headlines. Expect satire, debate and plenty of uncomfortable questions as the panel cuts through the noise and examines what’s really going on behind the political spectacle.

title: The future of health is prediction
description: Why wait for illness when your blood already holds the key to your future health? Humanity CEO Peter Ward breaks down how AI can read standard blood panels to measure biological age and flag disease risks long before symptoms surface.

title: Why the real work of agentic AI starts after launch [Hosted by Heidi AI]
description: Join Yu Liu from Heidi on what it takes to implement AI agents at scale. Learn how to fine-tune models to drive better outcomes affordably, and why scaling law says to build a specialised flywheel. Please be aware that attendance is first-come, first-served.

title: Data engineering meetup
description: Connect with data engineers, architects, and analytics specialists building reliable data pipelines and infrastructure.

title: AI vs. AI: The battle for the cyber advantage
description: AI is now a tool, a target, and a force multiplier for modern adversaries. Operating at superhuman speed, it has overhauled the threat landscape, turning frontier AI capabilities into offensive tactics for nation-state actors and cybercriminals alike. From DPRK-backed operations to top criminal enterprises, weaponized AI presents a new reality. Join CrowdStrike’s Zeki Turedi to explore the front lines of AI cyber warfare and learn how defenders can turn the tables to fight AI with AI.

timeslot_participations.name: Zeki Turedi
timeslot_participations.job_title: Field CTO for Europe, Middle East, and Africa

title: Statecraft or interference? The US NGO complex
description: For decades, the United States has projected its soft power through the promotion of democracy, human rights, and freedom via NGOs. This provided the US safe cover for meddling in the affairs of countries whose policies it did not approve of whilst evading direct responsibility. With the shuttering of USAID, has America decided to limit foreign interference or put global human rights below the list of priorities? Here to discuss this and more is Mike Benz, formerly of the State Department now head of the Foundation for Freedom Online.

timeslot_participations.name: Mike Benz
timeslot_participations.job_title: Executive Director of the Foundation For Freedom Online

title: Build for people: A ‘human x car x home’ approach
description: Xiaomi started by challenging the smartphone market. Today, its ambition for smart living extends across more aspects of everyday life, from personal technology, the home to mobility and beyond, with AI integrates experiences. Xiaomi CMO Fei Xu explores what it takes to build a global brand as a product company becomes an entire smart ecosystem.

title: Rogue agents live
description: What happens when autonomous AI agents are given full control of a simulated world? Watch Emergence AI co-founder Satya Nitta run a live simulation where agents break the rules in real time, inventing secret languages, pursuing unintended goals, and colluding, proving why today’s model safeguards aren't enough for true AI autonomy.

title: Ready or not, here AI comes: Is your enterprise built for scale?
description: Every enterprise is racing to adopt AI. But fewer are asking the harder questions: is their infrastructure actually ready for AI, and can they remain resilient amid shifting geopolitical and regulatory pressures? Kyndryl Chairman and CEO Martin Schroeter discusses moving past pilots and into the operational realities of running AI reliably, securely and at scale. From modernising legacy IT to defending against cyber threats and ensuring business continuity, this fireside chat explores why the companies that will succeed are those that treat AI readiness as an organisational challenge - not just a technological one.

title: What to expect in the new era of expecting
description: Fertility care was built to respond only after something has already gone wrong. This conversation extends past the fertility visit itself to what's actually changing: earlier detection and AI-driven diagnostics at the point of care, full automation of the embryology lab through AURA, and capital that is finally separating real breakthroughs from hype in women's health.

title: "Surviving Thriving in the age of Agentic Commerce"
description: E-commerce is undergoing a fundamental shift: moving from consumers browsing catalogues to autonomous AI agents assisting in discovering, deciding, and transacting on their behalf. In this forward-looking talk, Zalando CTO Graeme Smith explores what happens when intelligent agents become an additional discovery and shopping channel—acting on preferences, style, and budget and whether humans will remain the primary shoppers or not.

title: Outsmarting AI: Defence at machine speed
description: Autonomous AI attacks move in seconds, leaving traditional security behind and compressing the vulnerability exploitation window. Meanwhile, most organizations can't say exactly what their AI agents are doing with their sensitive data. Proofpoint CEO Sumit Dhawan will explore whether security can actually keep pace with agentic AI and whether AI guardrails are enough to move ​workforces from vulnerable attack surfaces to protected enterprises.

title: Rethinking innovation ecosystems for global impact [Hosted by Invest São Paulo]
description: Discover how São Paulo’s innovation ecosystem turns breakthrough research into scalable solutions by connecting science, talent, capital and international networks to drive real global impact. Please be aware that attendance is first-come, first-served.

title: The ethical alternatives to big tech
description: Our lives in the modern world have become increasingly dominated by a small number of enormous companies, that each wield an unprecedented amount of power. Too often they use this power to trample on our rights and restrict our freedoms. In this talk we hear from a man leading the fight back against big tech about how to build ethical alternatives to the tools that have come to dominate our lives.

title: AI joins the marketing team: Deutsche Bahn case study [Hosted by Uplane]

title: Built to last: The reinvention and reimagining of iconic brands

title: Beyond the IPO: The new exit playbook

title: The end of trial and error

title: The biological bottleneck

title: Heritage in motion: How digital is redefining the sports brand experience

title: The next AI race is physical: From prototype to productivity
description: AI is moving off the screen and into the physical world, from robotic arms on factory floors to flying robots with dexterous hands. description: Wellness is shifting from raw data collection to deeply personal, proactive guidance. Delivering this tailored experience at scale is one of the defining technology challenges of the decade. title: Connecting the bots: Building secure infrastructure for inter-agent communication
description: As AI agents quickly become your primary users and customers, inter-bot traffic is surging. Yet, getting autonomous agents to communicate securely with each other remains a major unsolved bottleneck. Primitive founder Ethan Byrd breaks down how to build secure communication layers that unlock massive scale while protecting your underlying systems.

title: The $100 million prompt
description: As generative video collapses production costs, e-commerce is entering a new era at the intersection of AI, entertainment, and performance, where products launch through AI-powered content, shoppable media, and episodic microdramas built to entertain and convert. ​This talk explores how AI is transforming not just how brands advertise, but how the next generation of commerce is built, launched and scaled.

title: The attackers are open source. The defences aren't.
description: Online abuse operates like an open-source community where bad actors freely trade playbooks, while safety tools remain locked within deep-pocketed tech giants. But protecting the most vulnerable online shouldn’t depend on a platform’s profit margin or proprietary tech. Can accessible open-source tools level the playing field, or does decentralizing safety introduce new risks? Anne Bertucio de Hollembeak, COO of ROOST joins us for an honest discussion on the realities of digital harm and what it takes to build accessible defences that level the playing field.

title: You onboarded 1, 000 users last month. How many were real?
description: Fake sign-ups used to have obvious tells: disposable emails, burner phone numbers. AI has erased most of those tells, and fraudulent accounts now pass the same checks real users do. That means skewed onboarding metrics and wasted ad spend, with fraud teams often unable to tell the difference until the damage is done. This session looks at what has changed in synthetic identity and bot-driven sign-up fraud. Matias Berny, Co-founder and CEO of Prelude, draws on data from more than 1 billion authntications to show which signals still separate real users from fake ones, and where older fraud checks fall short.

title: The world builders: how new powers are reshaping the global order
description: For five hundred years, power meant controlling territory. Today, the struggle is no longer over land. It is over the systems that shape the world: chips, AI, networks, platforms, and energy. This fireside chat explores how a handful of powers are building the infrastructure and rules that others must navigate. Most nations are players in a game they didn’t create. A few are world builders.

timeslot_participations.job_title: Geopolitical analyst, author and former Portuguese Secretary of State

title: Search, rebuilt for robots
description: Search was built for humans, not AI agents, and Seltz is building the engine they actually need. Will Wells spotted that early and backed it at Speedinvest; now he and founder Antonio Mallia talk about the bet, the friction, and what comes next.

title: World models for the physical world
description: As AI moves beyond language and digital environments, the next frontier is understanding and interacting with the physical world. In this keynote, Cristian Bodnar, founding member of Prometheus, will explore how world models can enable machines to reason about physical environments, predict how they evolve, and make better decisions under uncertainty.

title: Beyond unhinged: Duolingo’s next chapter
description: Duolingo became one of the world's most recognizable brands by mastering social media and embracing internet culture. But today’s marketing landscape is changing, as audiences fragment across platforms, creators, and communities. Join CMO Manu Orssaud as he explores their next phase of growth and discusses how companies can evolve from grabbing attention to building a brand people keep coming back to.

title: How software ate the SIM: Unpacking the eSIM transition
description: Although the eSIM was merely a spec sheet in 2016, more than 130 million travellers rely on it today. Emre Demirel, co-founder and CEO of Roamless, breaks down how software dismantled legacy telecom infrastructure and created a brand-new consumer category. Learn the critical signals that shaped the market's tipping point, and discover how telcos, travel platforms and app builders can use "connectivity as a feature" over the next decade.

title: Solving the cold start problem in female health
description: Just like tech systems glitch without enough data, women’s health suffers from decades of missing research and forgotten data. Beyond the current funding hype, how do we actually bridge this gap? Discover how AI uses data and inference to solve healthcare's "cold start" problem, turning missing data into real answers while keeping privacy and accuracy front and centre.

title: Running quantum-accurate physics on standard GPUs
description: You don’t need a cryogenic quantum computer in your basement to solve quantum-level computational problems today. Stefan Leichenauer explains how SandboxAQ bridges quantum physics and high-performance classical hardware using cloud infrastructure and GPU acceleration. Find out how scientists and software developers are using massive, highly parallel physics simulations and quantitative AI for drug discovery and materials science.

title: Big Tech detox
description: Big Tech’s reliance on surveillance and data monetization is hitting a tipping point as AI accelerates. As users across Europe, Canada, and beyond reject dominant legacy platforms, a massive shift toward digital sovereignty is underway. Join Vivaldi CEO Jon von Tetzchner and Proton COO Raphael Auphan as they unpack what it actually takes to dismantle the traditional stack, defend consumer rights, and shape a more secure digital future.

title: Customers hold the secret sauce, and AI can't cook without it
description: As AI radically lowers the barrier to creation, raw technical capability is no longer a differentiator among companies. True success hinges specifically on understanding customer taste and treating it as the secret sauce of business. In a world of infinite potential products, the rarest skill becomes knowing which problems matter, what to build, and why people will choose it. Ultimately, the winners of this era won't be the companies with the most AI, but those that stay closest to the humans they are building for.

title: Your web needs therapy: Is your web ready for AI? [Hosted by Pantheon]
description: Is your web estate ready for the AI era? Diagnose your digital operation, benchmark your readiness and see how modern workflows help teams move faster, scale confidently and stay in control. Please be aware that attendance is first-come, first-served.

description: Explore what gaming can teach us about product design, from understanding behaviour and intent to creating personalised journeys, smarter offers and experiences that keep users coming back. Please be aware that attendance is first-come, first-served.

title: After the Iran war: A new Middle East order?
description: The war with Iran has reshaped the Middle East. As the dust settles, old alliances are shifting, regional powers are recalibrating and the balance of influence is being redrawn. This discussion will explore what comes next, from Iran’s future role and Israel’s regional position to the ambitions of Saudi Arabia, Turkey and the Gulf states, and the wider contest between the US, China and Russia. Who gains, who loses, and what will the new Middle East look like?

title: The death of window shopping
description: When AI agents only buy what you request and social algorithms only echo past habits, where does that leave spontaneity? Cart.com co-founder Remington Tonar defends the digital storefront and cart—not as relic tools of the past, but as essential engines for emotional buying, unexpected discovery, and critical intent data in an automated world.

title: Reclaiming human agency in the machine era
description: As AI models threaten to reduce humans to passive consumers of automated content, entrepreneurship remains our most powerful outlet for agency and purpose. Join Bill Gross  as he presents a compelling framework for human-AI collaboration: software identifies the opportunity and drafts the blueprint, while human founders bring the empathy, grit, and execution required to bring it to life in the real world.

title: From local to limitless: Why creativity should know no boundaries
description: What if your best creative ideas could travel anywhere, across borders, cultures and even into space? This talk explores how creative AI is helping brands overcome traditional barriers to growth, reimagining existing campaigns for new audiences without losing what makes them distinctive. The session finishes with a live demonstration using Web Summit itself, transforming its Lisbon identity for globally recognised locations before taking the event somewhere entirely unexpected: outer space.

title: Navigating AI in European health

Join Sumsub co-founders Andrew and Jacob Sever and Marina Khaustova, COO of Crystal Intelligence, to explore why AI agents need digital identities of their own. They’ll break down why verifying the human behind the AI is only the first step, and how modern trust infrastructure will define the future of secure financial services.

title: The physical shadow of the digital economy
description: AI agents can decide what to buy in milliseconds. But whatever they order still moves through a physical supply chain built over decades. Valentyn Frechka, inventor of a process that turns urban fallen leaves into paper packaging, argues that some of the biggest opportunities hide in the gaps between existing systems, and shares what it takes to turn one such connection into something that works at industrial scale.

title: Beyond the model: scaling AI agents for professional work

title: To SaaS and beyond: How Duncan Lennox is transforming HubSpot
description: What does it take to steer a global software power from the SaaS era into the AI era? When Duncan Lennox stepped in as HubSpot chief product and technology officer, he took on the high-stakes challenge of rearchitecting product strategy across a multi-billion-dollar company. In this keynote, Duncan breaks down how to balance legacy scale with rapid innovation, providing an unfiltered playbook for leading massive organisational change.

description: From multi-club ownership to institutional investment, investors are looking beyond football’s biggest clubs for new ways to create value. David Dwinger, Co-Founder and President of Estrella Football Group; Massimo Marinelli, Founder of Berkida Ventures, Operating Partner at Corrum Capital and Senior Adviser to 49ers Enterprises; and André Mosqueira do Amaral, CEO of Liga Portugal, explore where opportunities sit across the football pyramid, what happens after an investment is made, the role of technology in building club value, and how the US and European markets compare.

title: The enterprise trust stack: why AI and SaaS need each other
description: As enterprise AI accelerates, two myths dominate: that AI will replace SaaS, and that winning requires the smartest model. title: The election interference we don't talk about

Here bots, troll farms and coordinated influence networks can shape public debate, amplify misleading narratives and manipuling perceptions of public opinion. title: When cameras start thinking
description: The AI conversation has been so focused on robots and self-driving cars, but there's a massive opportunity for AI that understands the physical spaces and buildings people already occupy. Learn from Verkada's Co-founder & CEO how advances in computer vision are transforming existing cameras into intelligent systems that improve security, safety, and operations across industries in real time, shifting organizations from reactive video review to proactive, AI-powered intervention.

title: Made in China: Closing the trust gap
description: Chinese companies are building some of the world’s most innovative products and shaping global commerce. This panel looks at how they turn reach into lasting trust through local storytelling, cultural fluency and a customer experience that keeps buyers coming back.

title: Beyond the Prompt: Building Resilient Systems in the Vibe Coding Era
description: As natural language replaces syntax, non-technical creators are generating functional code with a single prompt. But when prototype code breaks at enterprise scale, who fixes it? Duncan Lennox explores how developer jobs aren't disappearing, they're shifting up the stack toward system architecture, security, and long-term reliability. Learn what skills developers must cultivate to thrive as the human guardians of AI-generated infrastructure.

title: From Woke 1.0 to Woke 2.0: What does it mean and who is rewriting it?
description: “Woke” has evolved from a term for social awareness into one of the defining political and cultural battlegrounds of our time. This talk explores what has changed, why institutions and corporations are rethinking their approach, and who is shaping the next version of the debate. From politics and media to technology and AI, who gets to define what is acceptable and who is rewriting the rules?

timeslot_participations.name: Steve Clemons
timeslot_participations.job_title: Host of The Bottom Line; Editor at Large, National Interest

title: Selling sport: Has it gone too far?
description: Sport is becoming a global IP asset class. Multi-billion-dollar sports funds, private equity investments, media rights deals, and creator-driven franchises are reshaping how sport is valued, owned, and commercialised. As FIFA explores new investment structures and clubs/leagues become media businesses, who actually owns the future of value of sport?

title: Securing the AI frontline
description: Modern conflict no longer stays in the cloud. As state-sponsored actors and advanced cybercriminals target autonomous systems, critical infrastructure, and military hardware, the front line of cyber defense has been pushed to the limit. Now, it’s up to democratic nations to adapt, respond, and secure the tactical edge.

title: The death of the fixed factory
description: For decades, manufacturing has been locked into fixed tooling and rigid lines that are slow and costly to change. Join Machina Labs Co-founder & CEO Edward Mehr as he reveals how AI-driven robotics let facilities adapt to new parts, materials, and geometries through software instead of retooling – with real implications for defense, auto, and beyond.

title: Vivaldi v Goliath: The case for sovereign code
description: From the creator of Opera and CEO of Vivaldi, Jon von Tetzchner comes a counter-trend masterclass in web ethics. While big tech rushes to embed AI into every application, Vivaldi intentionally avoids integrating AI into the browser to protect data privacy. Learn why Europe needs to construct its own independent web infrastructure to maintain digital sovereignty, and how this privacy-first philosophy is putting Vivaldi at the frontier of a market that did not exist before.

title: Beyond the dashboard: how AI agents are rewiring finance operations
description: Finance teams still lose days reconciling payments, chasing invoices and updating systems by hand. Now, AI agents are moving beyond copilots and dashboards to take ownership of entire workflows. Caitlin, co-founder and CEO of Fazeshift, reveals why accounts receivable is becoming a proving ground for autonomous finance and what happens when software stops surfacing insights and starts owning outcomes.

title: ⚖️ Legaltech meetup
description: Law is next in line for an AI makeover ⚖️! Meet legaltech founders, lawyers and investors, and swap notes on how legal work is changing. See you there!

title: Building AI products without building everything [Hosted by Open VSX]
description: Discover how Open VSX and open source foundations help teams build AI products faster. Explore how startups such as Cursor and Windsurf use them to challenge established platforms and create new AI experiences at scale. Please be aware that attendance is first-come, first-served.

title: Inside the making of MOURINHO
description: Producer and Head of Development at Ventureland, Miles Coleman goes behind the scenes of MOURINHO, sharing how the documentary came together and exploring how the film captures one of football's most compelling figures and what its production reveals about the future of sports storytelling.

title: The sovereign supercomputer
description: Training frontier models no longer requires begging for access to Silicon Valley cloud clusters. Powered by the UK’s Isambard-AI supercomputer, Lumen Sovereign proves that public compute initiatives can build independent, cutting-edge foundation models on home soil. Join Cosine's Yang Li as he breaks down the technical execution behind training sovereign AI, mapping out how national infrastructure programs can deliver genuine, state-level technological leverage.

title: The future of politics: Swiping right on Gen-Z
description: Politicians love to say they want to "secure the youth vote", yet few are willing to step aside to make room for them. So, what does winning over this online generation actually take? Gen-Z is far from indifferent, they are redefining political power through digital activism and social justice. This panel of activists, strategists, creators, and journalists is offering a candid look at the future of politics and how to campaign to a generation that doesn't just consume the conversation, but controls it.

title: AI watched 25 years of news. What did it see?
description: What happens when you process 25 years of global news across 100+ languages through modern AI? In this keynote, GDELT Project founder Kalev Leetaru unpacks the hidden geopolitical and cultural trends uncovered from millions of hours of global media and the software engineering required to build it. Step under the hood of planetary-scale data architecture to see how real-time NLP, automated translation and petabyte-scale pipelines can transform decades of chaotic global noise into clean, queryable data that developers can use to build new intelligent tools.

title: How physical AI is transforming agriculture
description: What happens when machine intelligence meets living biology? Join Hiroki Koga, Co-Founder & CEO of Oishii, to explore how real-world algorithms, robotics, and biology are transforming agriculture and what the future of farm jobs, food production, and physical-goods commerce looks like when technology goes hands-on.

timeslot_participations.name: Vitus Spehar
timeslot_participations.job_title: Creator of Under The Desk News

title: Reinventing icons: The new playbook for legendary IP
description: Nostalgia alone is no longer enough to keep iconic characters relevant. As audiences seek deeper worlds, flawed heroes and stories that reflect the cultural moment, entertainment brands face a challenge: how do you evolve beloved IP without losing what made it iconic? Mark Lester, fresh from helping to reimagine Lara Croft, joins Jon Rosenblatt of Clash of Clans to explore how global franchises are adapting for a new generation.

timeslot_participations.name: Jon Rosenblatt
timeslot_participations.job_title: VP of Global Marketing, Clash of Clans

title: What AI can do for humanity
description: In a tech landscape dominated by conversations about speed, efficiency, and scaling models, it’s easy to lose sight of why we build. Join Rodrigo Moran, Global Director of Creative at Microsoft as he cuts through the noise of AI hype to focus on what matters most: human-centric purpose. Discover how we can move beyond mere automation to design a future where AI truly serves humanity.

title: How LALIGA is shaping football's AI future
description: Ana Rosa Victoria, Head of Innovation at LALIGA, discusses how AI is reshaping football, from agentic AI and digital twins to smart stadiums and hyper-personalised fan experiences, and how a league can move from using technology to building it.

title: Robots: Forever on the horizon, or finally within reach?
description: Why are commercial robots always 10 years away? Drawing on his own failed attempt to build a robotics company a decade ago, Rodion breaks down the four core engineering constraints that make robotics hard: payload, data, compute and validation. He shares what has changed to make deployment possible today, offering essential lessons for founders inside and outside the robotics space.

title: 😎 Vibe coders meetup
description: Calling all vibe coders at Web Summit: your people are here! 🙌🏼. Exchange insights, discuss challenges, and expand your network. Join us!

title: 🔁 Serial founders meetup
description: Been there, built that, and doing it again? Meet fellow serial founders, swap lessons from your previous companies and compare what you're doing differently this time 🔁. See you there!

title: The cloud has reached its breaking point: why physical AI needs a new architecture
description: Cloud infrastructure powered yesterday's digital services, but as AI moves into the physical world, centralised computing is hitting a wall. Real-time physical systems running transport and critical infrastructure cannot survive a round trip to a distant data centre. Latency is physics, and physics does not negotiate. As AHOY founder and CEO Jamil Shinawi explores, if your AI does not run on infrastructure you control, you do not control it.

title: AI empowering marginalised communities
description: AI could widen inequality or become a powerful tool for expanding opportunity. This conversation brings together Rodney Bullard, Debra Lam and Jessica Renteria to explore how communities too often left behind by technology can gain access to AI, skills and economic opportunity. From digital literacy and workforce development to inclusive innovation, the discussion asks how we can make AI work for the many and not the few.

title: Health's data shift: From episodic care to continuous prevention
description: Healthcare has long relied on sporadic snapshots like annual check-ups. Join Dor Kilroy, CCO at Oura, as she explores how continuous wearable data shifts medicine from reactive treatment to proactive prevention, and what it takes to scale those insights into better health outcomes.

title: The human network: Bingo, Big Ideas & Beautiful connections with Community Partner, LSE Generate
description: Join the London School of Economics for a fast-paced, playful community experience that combines Human Bingo, systems thinking and entrepreneurial curiosity to explore how the most interesting ideas often emerge when unexpected people, perspectives and problems collide.

description: How many people from Ireland are walking around Web Summit right now? Let's find out 👋! Meet, share insights, and spot familiar faces around the venue. See you there!

title: 🤳 Building a business on social meetup
description: Your best salesperson might be a 30-second video. Meet the creators, social sellers, and brand builders proving it at Web Summit. Join us!

title: 🇪🇬 Egypt meetup
description: How many people from Egypt are walking around Web Summit right now? Let's find out 👋! Meet, share insights, and spot familiar faces around the venue. See you there!

title: Making silicon sexy: How Cerebras turned hard tech into a blockbuster IPO
description: Technical breakthroughs aren’t enough to win Wall Street. You need a story that scales alongside your compute. This fireside conversation unpacks how to turn complex hardware innovation into a compelling narrative—one that captures attention, builds a category, and creates momentum on the road to a blockbuster IPO.

title: The business behind the badge
description: The modern football club is becoming a global media, marketing and commercial powerhouse. But turning millions of supporters into a sustainable business takes more than a famous badge. Peter Silverstone, Chief Business Officer at Juventus, explores how elite clubs are evolving their commercial playbook, leveraging first-party data and global partnerships to deepen fan engagement, maximise sponsorship value and generate new revenue streams.

title: Beyond the front door: Identity, access, and user trust
description: AI deepfakes don’t stop at the front door, they target every stage of the user lifecycle from initial onboarding to internal access. But stronger security shouldn't come at the cost of privacy. Join Delinea CEO Art Gilliland and Persona CEO Rick Song to explore how identity verification and privileged access management converge to prevent fraud and protect privacy without adding friction. In a world where personal data is becoming a risky commodity, how do we balance threat prevention with user trust?

title: Deus ex machina: Can AI replace God?
description: Religion and mythology have been used, for millenia, to seize power. As AI progresses in its capabilities, the narratives around it are taking on an increasingly religious, or theistic, tone. In this session we explore how these shifts in language are used by elites to obtain and entrench their power. Can AI replace God, and if it can, what does that mean for us?

title: Betting against the moat
description: Every incumbent in enterprise software says the same thing: decades of proprietary data and workflow lock-in make them impossible to dislodge. Caitlin Leksana is betting that's exactly the kind of confidence that goes extinct once AI agents can do the job end to end – and Rocio Wu backed her with millions of investor dollars to prove it. In this session, Caitlin and Rocio debate whether a 'moat' still means anything in enterprise software, or whether it's just what the losing side says on the way out.

title: Why raw AI is useless without the deployment engine
description: With raw intelligence now a core factor of production, the true competitive advantage lies in how fast enterprises can turn models into functional software. In this session, Ciridae CEO Jack Soslow shares how real-economy businesses are skipping long multi-year roadmaps to deploy AI-native operating systems in weeks.

title: 🎬 Entertainment & media leaders meetup
description: Join fellow media executives, entertainment founders and content leaders for a meetup! Come connect with people shaping the future of content, streaming and storytelling. See you there!

title: 🤝 Hiring your first team meetup
description: Your first ten hires will shape your company for years 🤝. Meet founders building their early teams and swap notes on where to find talent and how to get culture right from day one. See you there!

title: 🥷 Solo founders meetup
description: Building a startup on your own? You don't have to network alone 🥷! Meet fellow solo founders, swap notes on doing it all and find people who get it. See you there!

title: The smartphone in your pocket is your next clinical lab
description: What if screening over 50 health biomarkers across 10 organs took less than two minutes on a standard smartphone? YOU(th) Founder & CEO Filippo Yacob reveals how machine learning and ubiquitous mobile sensors are democratising preventive longevity and transforming passive phones into active health screeners.

title: Building a brand from the baseline
description: Elite athletes are uniquely equipped to be founders—they process failure rapidly, execute under intense pressure and possess deep domain knowledge of what high-performance lifestyle and health products actually require. This panel dissects the operational realities, mental discipline and strategic advantage of building a startup from hotel rooms, locker rooms and international travel schedules.

title: Integration or assimilation? The immigration debate
description: Immigration is reshaping European politics, with parties once on the margins now winning significant support amid public concern over housing, security, and national identity. Governments have responded with measures ranging from tighter border controls to reduced work permits. Our panel asks: ahat do we expect of newcomers once they arrive? Should they adopt the host society’s culture and norms through assimilation, or should societies make room for cultural difference within a shared civic framework via integration?

title: Sound that belongs: How AI is changing music for video
description: What if the soundtrack was built around your video, not the other way around? Keli Li, co-founder of Sonilo and former head of global music at TikTok, and creator Joey Reed (6.2M followers on TikTok) discuss how AI is changing music for video: what creators actually need from audio, what usage rights a creator has from AI-generated music, and whether a perfect soundtrack is now one click away.

title: Three companies before product-market fit: What each one taught us
description: Building a high-growth company rarely happens on the first try. Bruno, Founder of Cumbuca, breaks down the hard-won lessons from his previous startups. From building products nobody needed to battling unit economics, and how applying those failures turned Cumbuca B2B into a profitable platform processing 10.5 million transactions.

title: Achieving the impossible
description: Professional big-wave surfer Lucas “Chumbo” Chianca and skimboarding world champion Lucas Fink are pushing the limits of what athletes can achieve, sharing perspectives on taking on Nazaré’s monster waves and connecting with global audiences. This session draws inspiration from the risks, mindset and determination behind their sport, exploring how extraordinary performances can translate into global recognition, major sponsorships and new opportunities for athletes and brands.

title: 📚 Edtech startups meetup
description: What's the next big shift in Edtech? Debate it with peers who are living it 🚀. Connect with peers shaping the future of your field. Looking forward to seeing you!

title: Rebuilding open source with AI: Lessons Learned
description: How we write software has fundamentally changed. Where we used to sweat over every little detail in source files, we now spend most of our time discussing high level direction with our agents. Prisma CEO Søren Bramer Schmidt shares lessons learned from rewriting Prisma from scratch with AI. Learn how to make the most of coding agents in 2026, and how the changing landscape affects open source libraries.

title: Digital transformation and dynamism in service delivery
description: How can governments and international organisations use digital technology to make public services faster, simpler and more accessible? This talk discusses how modernisation is increasingly taking the form of AI, digital identity and online services, along with the challenges around security, inclusion and implementation at scale.

title: The engine behind the agent
description: As AI agents take over web search from humans, their effectiveness hinges entirely on data quality. This session breaks down the mechanics of ideal search and examines how underlying retrieval systems directly determine AI accuracy, speed, and cost.

title: Building systems that never sleep: Architecture lessons from global travel
description: When a platform processes transactions across every time zone on Earth, “scheduled maintenance” isn't an option. In this session, Michael Esquibel breaks down how engineering teams design resilient infrastructure that stays online through surging demand, unexpected disruptions and constant updates. Discover the balance between speed, stability and smart architecture when your code powers real-world movement around the clock.

title: Frontline Europe: AI, Sovereignty and Truth
description: Central Europe sits at the intersection of AI’s two hard questions: security and technological dependence. Bordering a war and facing sustained Russian information operations, the region relies on models and chips it does not control. The question is not just how Europe regulates AI, but how mid-sized democracies secure their technology, verify information and keep their information spaces open under pressure. Since 2012, Aspen Institute CE has brought together leaders across Czechia, Poland, Hungary and Slovakia, enabling us to unite former ministers, a head of state and AI researchers on one stage.
